requirements.text: About/approximately means within 20% of the cited amount; a/an/the/said mean one or more unless context dictates otherwise.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Keep approximation metadata separate from exact operational settings and numerical parity tolerances.

requirements.text: IR baseline DC-offset shifts associated with contraction-related blood-volume occlusion support optical myography; IR-DC baseline crash is a force proxy; occlusion is temporary displacement of blood volume.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Preserve baseline-relative direction; no newtons/absolute bite-force conversion is supplied.

requirements.text: First SpO2 measurement is less than 90% of its SpO2 baseline.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Strict relative predicate, separate from absolute SpO2 <90 percentage points.

requirements.text: First IR-DC measurement is less than 85% of its baseline; Example 2 describes >15% signal drop as a crash example.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Equality at 85% baseline / 15% depth is excluded; not a universal clench threshold.

requirements.text: IR-DC drop occurs after the first SpO2 measurement; second SpO2 exceeds 90% of baseline after the first IR-DC measurement.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Use strict sample timestamps, not arrival order; equal recovery threshold is not recovery.

requirements.text: Oxygen desaturation event is peripheral oxygen saturation less than 90%; Fig.3 description uses an absolute dip, IR-DC dip and recovery.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Do not substitute the absolute predicate for R03's relative predicate.

requirements.text: Declining SpO2 is followed by an immediate IR-DC crash in Example 2.
requirements.implementation_consequence: No numeric latency, zero-lag requirement or 4.9-second delay may be inferred.

requirements.text: Occlusion Depth is a drop in an established IR-DC baseline; Example 1 quantifies percentage drop responding to muscle movement.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Expose signed raw shift, relative shift and conventional percentage-depth proposal with units and baseline provenance, not a patent-supplied formula.

requirements.text: TFI assesses exhaustion of masseter and/or temporalis from spectral shift and/or cumulative IR-baseline slope change during continuous monitoring of at least four hours; declining recovery rate after tonic clench indicates reduced perfusion/recovery capacity.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Continuous-coverage qualification and approved formula are separate gates; use persisted fatigue history, not a four-hour ML tensor.

requirements.text: SASHB means total area under an SpO2 saturation curve.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Block authoritative calculation pending D08; do not silently use a desaturation-deficit-area clinical formula.

requirements.text: Two or more wavelengths may isolate muscle activity from circulatory noise; multiple wavelengths may be detected at the same time, with 660 nm and 880 nm simultaneous as an example.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Retain channel identity and timing; exact example wavelengths are optional, not software frequency bands.

requirements.text: Emission and reflected/transmitted/scattered detection wavelength alternatives are about 500 nm, 500-1100 nm, 600-1000 nm, 700-900 nm, or 1100 nm.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Hardware/profile metadata; preserve all alternatives and R01 qualifier; do not confuse nm and Hz.

requirements.text: Hemodynamic occlusion and/or kinetic data may be resampled to about 10 Hz, 10-50 Hz, 15-45 Hz, 20-40 Hz, 25-35 Hz, or 50 Hz.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Exact 50 Hz is a proposed engineering profile supported by an alternative, not patent-mandated.

requirements.text: Acquire reflected-light baseline while temporalis/masseter are not contracting; preserve every approximate acquisition period.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Keep resting acquisition separate from contracting positive controls; duration choices remain D03.

requirements.text: Baseline may update dynamically over multi-hour monitoring to account for longitudinal hemodynamic shifts and exhaustion metrics.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Monitoring duration is not refresh cadence. Preserve recovery/trend history; about four hours does not relax exact TFI minimum.

requirements.text: Compare contracting reflected-light readings with baseline to establish positive control and SNR; repeated comparisons with baseline and/or control support offset-shift to occlusion pattern to diagnosis/TFI.
requirements.implementation_consequence: D04 must define estimators and control acceptance; output is not automatic diagnosis.

requirements.text: On pocket placement, measure signal strength and SNR; select the pocket with highest SNR.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Comparative selection only; define estimator, ties and missingness before implementation.

requirements.text: Accelerometer kinetic/rhythmic movement is associated with phasic grinding; PPG with tonic clenching; combined SpO2/IR-DC with airway rescue; accelerometer magnitude, motion power and IR patterns aid differentiation.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Feature definitions remain D06; scripted activity durations are not operational classification thresholds.

requirements.text: Contact pressure is essential for optical coupling; temporalis/masseter alternatives are about 3 mmHg, 3-20 mmHg, 5-17 mmHg, 7-15 mmHg, 9-13 mmHg, or 17 mmHg.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Metadata only unless calibrated physical measurement exists; software cannot infer measured mmHg from uncalibrated optical data.

requirements.text: Example 1 target contact pressure is 5-15 mmHg without about.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Distinct validation setup target, not universal runtime pressure or clench threshold.

requirements.text: Example 1 resting IR-DC baseline is 1.5-2.5 V, ideally less than 2.8 V.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Require calibration/firmware/gain provenance; do not substitute ADC counts or universal exclusions.

requirements.text: Example 1 runs 00:00-06:00 through all ten rest, clench, grinding, simulated apnea, rescue and recovery segments.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Keep complete versioned example labels; use simulated/replayed fixtures only pending D09.

requirements.text: Five housing sync taps in 01:00-01:10.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Count physical events, not five samples; do not remove historical three-tap profile silently.

requirements.text: Example 2 reports temporalis ICC 0.70 versus traditional masseter ICC 0.31.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Reported source evidence, not classifier confidence, guaranteed reliability or release cutoff.

requirements.text: Listed values include SpO2, IR-DC, accelerometer magnitude, kinetic movement, heart rate, SASHB and MFI; MFI is undefined and not expressly equated to TFI.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Keep undefined metrics explicit and disabled; HR/SpO2 calculation requires validated implementation provenance.

requirements.text: Sensors may operate independently, sequentially and/or simultaneously; discrete pockets use angular/linear ear-anchor offsets, tragus distance estimation, photogrammetry/3D scanning and highest-SNR placement guidance.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Distinguish estimated and measured geometry; do not invent angles, distances or timing tolerances.

requirements.text: Apnea window spans breathing cessation to oxygen desaturation; airway rescue event spans breathing cessation to restored saturation.
requirements.implementation_consequence: A SpO2/IR sequence alone cannot supply a measured breathing-cessation timestamp.

requirements.text: Haptic/stimulus may follow tonic, phasic or rescue events and may shift sleep position or induce micro-arousal.
requirements.implementation_consequence: No autonomous intervention is authorized; record disabled capability metadata only.

requirements.text: Asymmetrical lock-and-key pockets may permit only one insertion orientation.
requirements.implementation_consequence: Physical fit metadata where supported, not a numerical accelerometer orientation rule.
